description: Complete compile-only benchmark measurements with -ldflags=-w. No test binaries were executed.

methodology.affinity: first N physical cores, CPUs 0..N-1, no SMT siblings
methodology.orchestrion_aspects: existing gotesting YAML only; no all-integrations import
methodology.cold: 2 rounds with empty independent GOCACHE; module cache and OS page cache warm, offline. Rotate order. Delete task-owned cache after round1/each cell. Before each cold run, remove only this experiment binary outputs outside the timer to prevent reuse of an existing binary.
methodology.unchanged: 5 rounds, unchanged compile-only output, existing Go cache and binaries. Measure reuse explicitly, not fresh linking.
methodology.warm_link: 5 rounds, warm compiled packages, unique -ldflags=-buildid=... per round to force linking; no test-source changes or execution
methodology.edited: 3 rounds with identical per-round overlay adding an unused constant to one existing root _test.go; warm deps; forces changed test compile + link. Sources remain untouched.
methodology.AA: one native unchanged A/A pair per CPU/project, reported as noise control, not enough for statistical significance
methodology.trace_validation: CPU8 only: -x checks unchanged cache reuse, warm-link actual linker calls, edited test compile and link. These runs excluded from timing aggregates.
methodology.accounting: cpu.stat and memory.peak exclusive cgroup, all descendants including jobserver; wall until top-level command returns, post-exit drain wait recorded separately
methodology.qualification: Same original input hashes/modules; ELF output names/count; resolved SDK exact version no Replace and go mod verify; POC SDK build info, native SDK absent; actual SDK hook present both instrumentators and absent native. Orchestrion dynamically-added SDK is omitted from Go build metadata. No test binaries executed.
methodology.comparison: medians, min/max, all paired rounds; cold n=2 is descriptive only. No outlier filtering. No universal/causal optimization claim.
methodology.limits: 75 minutes from 2026-10-01T12:16:38Z; 8 GiB of new artifacts; <=300s per command with remaining overall-budget watchdog; no test execution.
methodology.edited_interpretation: First edited round also resets custom ldflags from preceding warm-link. Later rounds add an unused constant and need not change executable code. Preserve as diagnostic; no claim about rebuilding after a real test-body edit.
methodology.debug_info: All test binaries must have no .debug_* or .zdebug_* ELF sections; -w removes DWARF, preserves Go symbol table for SDK-hook qualification.
methodology.linker_flags: -w for every command in all variants/scenarios; warm-link additionally retains unique -buildid to force linking
methodology.comparison_to_previous: Historical same-input debug-info baseline retained. Cross-series differences are descriptive; not simultaneous paired timings.
methodology.harness_setup: Native and Orchestrion commands use PATH go, resolving to the same frozen toolchain binary. No setup failures occurred in this series.
